escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark studio at night): she stands with her body centred at about 62 % of the frame width, her head in the upper-middle of the frame, framed from the waist up, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. She holds her open right palm up at chest height and looks straight into the lens with a confident, knowing half-smile. Around her orbit FIVE glowing spheres of pure light, each the size of an orange, each a single saturated color: teal (#36C8BF), vivid orange (#FF6500), azure blue (#0375DB), red-orange (#F83902) and magenta-pink (#E86BD0). They travel along one tilted elliptical orbit that wraps tightly around her and stays inside the RIGHT 70% of the frame, that passes in front of her and behind her, and each sphere leaves a long luminous light trail of its own color along the orbit, like a long-exposure photograph, so the five colored trails braid into one orbit of light around her. The spheres are the only light sources besides a cool rim from behind: they paint her face, hand and jacket with colored light, one sphere hovers just above her open palm and lights it from below, one passes in front of the lens softly out of focus. Thin haze catches every colored trail. The LEFT 30% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no spheres, no trails, no objects. Rich contrast, punchy saturated color, no text, no logos of any other brand. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this vertical photo sits in the right column of a full-screen menu whose dark panel overlaps its LEFT third with a large curved corner at the top; so the SUBJECT and everything that carries the idea sits in the CENTRE-RIGHT of the frame, and the left third is calm continuation of the same scene, never empty and never a flat slab.
